description: Accompagnement de personnes à mobilité réduite dans les gares is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ces données fournissent le nombre d'accompagnements de personnes à mobilité réduite dans les gares depuis 2015. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Gares, Services voyageurs. Its keywords are Accessibilité, Gare de voyageurs. The portal shows 2022-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
